The leaks are usually boring. That is why they get missed.

Most service businesses do not lose money in one dramatic way. They lose it in small handoffs that break every week.

Missed calls

Good customers call while the team is busy. Nobody calls back fast enough. The job goes somewhere else.

Late invoices

The work is done, but the bill waits on notes, photos, parts, or office time. Cash sits still.

Forgotten follow-ups

Estimates go quiet. Reviews do not get asked for. Referrals never get chased.

Past customers nobody contacts again

A customer buys once, then disappears from the office list. The next job goes to whoever follows up first.

Start with the Cash Flow Assessment.

The Cash Flow Assessment is the paid first step. Stanley Systems looks at where money is being missed, what it likely costs, and which system should be built first.
